title: custom:sun-azimuth-card-pro
description: Where the sun is around the house today: a sky dial seen from above, or a 3D scene with the house, its shadow and the sky dome, plus the sides of the house the sun shines on. Computed from the Home Assistant coordinates.

house.description: Where the house faces and what its sides are called

front.description: The bearing the front of the house faces, degrees clockwise from north

roof.description: The roof: gable (ridge from the left side to the right, eaves at the front and the back), gable_front (the gable faces the front), hip or flat

sides.description: Your own names for the sides, left and right as you look at the front; false for a wall that never gets sun (shared with the neighbour). Unnamed sides are called by where they face, in the profile language

camera.description: 3D view: the bearing the camera looks toward (180 = standing north of the house, looking south)

camera_slider.description: 3D view: a slider under the plot to orbit the scene; the value is not saved

hover_preview.description: Hovering or tapping a side's timeline in the footer or the sun's path in the plot shows the sun at that time

show_house.description: Dial and 3D: the line naming the sides in the sun and what comes next

show_events.description: Dial and 3D: the sunrise, solar noon and sunset row

show_sides.description: The sides of the house footer with each side's sun window today

side.description: A name, or false for a wall that never gets sun
